hero.engineer.desc: Field inventor lobbing Cluster Grenades (12 dmg, 2.2m AoE) and calling down empowered auto-turrets.
hero.engineer.name: Engineer
hero.engineer.passive_desc: +20% Area & +12% Cooldown Reduction Weapon: Cluster Grenade (12 dmg, 2.2m AoE)
hero.engineer.ult_desc: Drops 3 empowered auto-turrets around you (34 DPS lasers for 9s); each landing sends out a 45 dmg shockwave.
hero.knight.desc: Sturdy warrior firing steady bolts (10 dmg, 2/s, 8m range) and protected by an impenetrable shield.
hero.knight.name: Knight
hero.knight.passive_desc: +100% Max HP Weapon: Steady Bolt (10 dmg, 2/s, 8m range)
hero.knight.ult_desc: Become invulnerable for 5 seconds and unleash a 4.5m shockwave dealing 40 damage and knocking enemies back.
hero.mage.desc: Arcane spellcaster firing explosive AoE bolts (14 dmg, 1.5m splash radius) and channeling devastating elemental power.
hero.mage.name: Mage
hero.mage.passive_desc: +20% Global Damage Weapon: Arcane Blast (14 AoE dmg, 1.5m splash)
hero.mage.ult_desc: Calls down 6 explosive meteors around you, dealing 80 AoE damage each in a 3.5m radius.
hero.necromancer.desc: Master of souls firing life-draining bolts (20% chance on hit to heal 2 HP) and harvesting essence for faster growth.
hero.necromancer.name: Necromancer
hero.necromancer.passive_desc: +35% XP & Magnet Radius Weapon: Soul Bolt (11 dmg, 20% chance to heal 2 HP on hit)
hero.necromancer.ult_desc: Fires 12 piercing spectral skulls in all directions (60 dmg each) and instantly heals 35% Max HP.
hero.paladin.desc: Holy bastion hurling piercing Holy Hammers (14 dmg, pierces 2 enemies) and consecrating the ground beneath.
hero.paladin.name: Paladin
hero.paladin.passive_desc: +25 Armor & +2 HP/s Weapon: Holy Hammer (14 dmg, pierces 2 targets)
hero.paladin.ult_desc: Consecrates a 5.5m golden circle for 6s: burns enemies inside (18 dmg every 0.5s) and heals you 3 HP per pulse while you stand in it.
hero.ranger.desc: Swift forest marksman firing rapid long-range arrows (9 dmg, 3.1/s, 11m range) and deadly volleys.
hero.ranger.name: Ranger
hero.ranger.passive_desc: +25% Move Speed Weapon: Rapid Bow (9 dmg, 3.1/s, 11m range)
hero.ranger.ult_desc: Unleashes 3 waves of arrows in an 8m radius, dealing 150 total damage (3x50) and slowing enemies by 50% for 4s.
synergy.aegis_phalanx.desc: Orbital Sword + Guardian Shields: Knocking enemies back with Guardian Shields unleashes a 2.4m Phalanx shockwave toward the nearest sword.
synergy.aegis_phalanx.name: Aegis Phalanx
synergy.blade_storm.desc: Orbital Sword + Boomerang: Orbital swords launch piercing spectral blades every 2.8s and on every 3rd Boomerang hit.
synergy.blade_storm.name: Blade Storm
synergy.cataclysm_vortex.desc: Black Hole + Arcane Tornado: Tornadoes passing through Black Hole (or expiring) destabilize into 6 explosive gravity shards.
synergy.cataclysm_vortex.name: Cataclysm Vortex
synergy.dragon_lord.desc: Dragon Whelp + Battle Fury: Dragon Whelps breathe Fury flames that pierce 3 enemies and leave burning embers underneath hit targets.
synergy.dragon_lord.name: Dragon Lord

synergy.overcharged_grid.name: Overcharged Grid
synergy.phantom_legion.desc: When a Shadow Decoy detonates it explodes into a ring of 8 dragon fireballs flying in every direction.
synergy.phantom_legion.name: Phantom Legion

synergy.ricochet_barrage.name: Ricochet Barrage
synergy.shatter_nova.desc: Seismic Hammer slams on frozen enemies deal 2.5x damage and burst them into 4 ice shards that strike neighbours.
synergy.shatter_nova.name: Shatter Nova

synergy.solar_eclipse.name: Solar Eclipse

synergy.steam_blast.name: Steam Blast
synergy.thunder_storm.desc: Chain Lightning + Ice Aura: Striking slowed enemies triggers a 90% deep freeze (0.65s) and fires 2 extra icy lightning arcs.
synergy.thunder_storm.name: Thunderstorm

synergy.toxic_inferno.name: Toxic Inferno

Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. 0.3s before a Skyfall Spire lands, an eclipse pulse drags enemies into the strike point; the strike deals +35% damage and blinds survivors.
talent.fortune_syn_solar_eclipse.name: Solar Eclipse
talent.fury_keystone.desc: KEYSTONE: +1 Active ability slot and an extra -8% cooldown on everything.
talent.fury_keystone.name: Overclocked Arsenal
talent.fury_r1a.desc: Permanently +6% critical hit chance. (Inner ring: also purchasable with coins.)
talent.fury_r1a.name: +6% Crit Chance
talent.fury_r1b.desc: Permanently +5% damage for weapon and abilities. (Inner ring: also purchasable with coins.)
talent.fury_r1b.name: +5% Damage
talent.fury_r2.desc: +10% radius / area for abilities, weapon splash and ultimates.
talent.fury_r2.name: +10% Global Area
talent.fury_r4a.name: +15% Boss Damage
talent.fury_r4b.desc: Abilities, weapon and ultimate recharge 10% faster.
talent.fury_r4b.name: +10% Cooldown Reduction
talent.fury_syn_blade_storm.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Blade Storm (orbital_small_sword + Boomerang). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Orbital Sword + Boomerang: Orbital swords launch piercing spectral blades every 2.8s and on every 3rd Boomerang hit.
talent.fury_syn_blade_storm.name: Blade Storm
talent.fury_syn_dragon_lord.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Dragon Lord (MiniDragon + BattleFury). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Dragon Whelp + Battle Fury: Dragon Whelps breathe Fury flames that pierce 3 enemies and leave burning embers underneath hit targets.
talent.fury_syn_dragon_lord.name: Dragon Lord
talent.fury_syn_ricochet_barrage.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Ricochet Barrage (BuzzsawChakram + CriticalLens). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Every critical hit of a Buzzsaw Chakram spawns a shrapnel mini-disc (2 ricochets) and speeds up the main disc.
talent.fury_syn_ricochet_barrage.name: Ricochet Barrage
talent.fury_syn_toxic_inferno.desc: Unlocks the reactive synergy Toxic Inferno (PoisonAlchemist + Fireball). Auto-activates in a run once both abilities are equipped. Poison Flask + Fireball: Fireball blasts ignite Poison Puddles into exploding napalm fields dealing 1.6x detonation and 2x burn damage.
talent.fury_syn_toxic_inferno.name: Toxic Inferno
